name: Stone (rough)
notes: Rough field stone and bedrock: walls, boulders, cave floors. Non-flammable. Density 2600 kg/m³ (granite about 2650). Very tough (400 hp) and never shatters from one impact. Friction 0.6 is the spec's reference for stone. Hard surfaces reflect sound (damping 0.05). Rough faces are a stamina climb (grade 2). It is the 0 dB footstep reference.
